stories.headline: Toronto man convicted of 2018 van attack no longer seeking appeal
stories.summary: Ontario's top court says Alek Minassian has abandoned the appeal of his convictions on 10 counts of first-degree murder and 16 of attempted murder.

stories.now: CityNews: TORONTO — The man who carried out a deadly van attack in Toronto eight years ago is no longer challenging his more than two dozen convictions.
stories.backstory: In April 2018 a van was driven along a North York sidewalk, killing 10 people and injuring 16. Minassian was convicted and in June 2022 received life in prison with no chance of parole for 25 years. He filed notice of appeal the following month, seeking to overturn the convictions or get a new trial.
